Ask a Professional

Have a question about a job?

Send a curious question. In a real version of this site, questions could be matched with verified professionals who can answer them.

Good questions sound like…

  • What is the first thing you do at work?
  • What tool could you not work without?
  • What surprised you about your job?
  • What did you want to be when you were seven?
About WhatDoYouDo

Work is easier to understand when a real person explains it.

WhatDoYouDo is a kid-friendly career magazine where real professionals explain what they actually do at work, using language a seven-year-old can understand.

Kids can explore different careers, discover what a typical day looks like, learn about tools people use, and find out what makes each job fun, challenging, or surprising.

Our rule

Never make a job sound bigger than it is.

Explain the real tasks. Show the ordinary moments. Keep the language simple. Let kids decide what sounds interesting.

The Curious Kids Letter

One new job. One tiny story.

A simple newsletter for families and classrooms. No noisy sales pitch — just interesting jobs and questions worth asking.

For Teachers, Parents & Professionals

Help a child discover a new possibility.

Professionals can contribute a real workday story; teachers can use the job library as a conversation starter; families can explore together.

Professionals

Share what you actually do, including the boring bits and the surprising bits.

Teachers

Use a job story as a starting point for reading, writing, research and class discussions.

Families

Ask “what sounds fun?” instead of “what will you be?”
